title: GTA 6 Reviews Could Drop the Day Before Launch (Rumor) 📝 #Shorts
description:
Rumor: GTA 6 reviews could go live on November 18, 2026, one day before launch. Insider NateTheHate posted the date and Insider Gaming says it independently verified it. Rockstar has not confirmed it. For reference, GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 both scored 97 on Metacritic, and GTA IV scored 98.

Sources: Insider Gaming, "Grand Theft Auto 6 Review Embargo Date Details"; Metacritic. Footage: official Rockstar Games GTA VI Trailer 2.
GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
